statements.statement: ChauffeurNet (paper B) uses mid-level input representations that facilitate training on real or simulated data and enable closed-loop simulation testing prior to deployment on real vehicles.
This approach contrasts with the end-to-end CNN method in paper A, which learns the entire processing pipeline from raw images.

The availability of CARLA (paper C), an open-source urban driving simulator supporting training, prototyping, and validation of autonomous driving models, provides a platform that aligns well with the mid-level representation approach for closed-loop testing.
Thus, mid-level representations combined with simulation platforms like CARLA enable safer and more flexible development workflows before real-world deployment.
